names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 2 Ιουνίου, «Άγιοι Φωτεινός ο Επίσκοπος, Σάνκτιος ο διάκονος, Βέτιος, Επάγαθος, Ποντικός, Βιβλίδης, Άτταλος, Αλέξανδρος, Μάτουρος και οι συν αυτώ Μάρτυρες», with the rank words left off.

The name as days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 14893 gives it, «Понтик Лионский, мч.», with the rank word taken off. Measured with the gate's own fold before writing: 'лионскии понтик' has no other holder.

death.note: saint.gr's head line for him reads «(; - 177)», and the entry says the company was perfected in martyrdom in 177 under the emperor Marcus Aurelius (161-180). The page gives no year of birth.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 2 июня ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Пофина , епископа Лионского и с ним пострадавших (ок. 177) Мц. Бландины и мч. Понтика Лионских (177).»

attestations.note: The day's third entry as `day-candidates.mjs` prints it is in fact TWO printed lines run together — «Сщмч. Пофина , епископа Лионского и с ним пострадавших (ок. 177)» and «Мц. Бландины и мч. Понтика Лионских (177)» — which is the merging the instrument is known to do; the three `name:` links behind it were counted and they are three. «и с ним пострадавших», and those who suffered with him, enumerates nobody and is not a folder; the other eight of the Lyons company this corpus holds took nothing from this day. Neither of the two lines links a /Life/ page, so the three readings here rest on the day lines and the three name pages and on nothing else, and the day page prints no hymn for any of them. azbyka.ru was not read. He is the мч. Понтик of the second of the two lines, and name page 14893 heads him «Понтик Лионский, мч.». The folder already holds 177 for his death off saint.gr, which is the year this line gives him, so the two sources agree and nothing of `dates` was touched. He is the one of the three who stands venerated greek on this same 2 June, and he is already related to this corpus's whole Lyons company.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (1 October 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 2ης Ιουνίου — «Άγιοι Φωτεινός ο Επίσκοπος, Σάνκτιος ο διάκονος, Βέτιος, Επάγαθος, Ποντικός, Βιβλίδης, Άτταλος, Αλέξανδρος, Μάτουρος και οι συν αυτώ Μάρτυρες»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 2 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and it does not carry the «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence. One page carries all nine, each with a head line of its own and the year «(; - 177)», and above them a heading for the unnamed companions; the enumeration is why there are nine folders here and not one. Lyons in Gaul is named as the place of the martyrdom and `locations` is left out all the same, because the corpus does not place a martyr on the strength of one clause in a one-sentence entry. No hymn is printed for any of them. Of Ponticus the page says nothing but his name, his rank of martyr and the year 177. It does not say how old he was, what he did, or in what order the company suffered.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (1 October 2026).
